coaching.headline: A 17-minute loss where we led objectives 10–6 but lost every tower (0–3) — leads that never became a close.
coaching.team: We won the early objective count (10-6) and still lost in 17 minutes because we converted none of it to structures (0 towers). coaching.whatShiftedIt: Convert objective leads to towers immediately — a 10–6 objective lead with 0 towers is a lead we threw. Ward before taking neutrals.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam

loadout.plain: Each empowered punch after an ability stacks attack speed. Weave ability, punch, ability, punch to keep the stacks up and land more hits between casts.

loadout.name: Demiurge
loadout.text: Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.
loadout.plain: Mostly a generic stat boost: every item you buy gives a bit more, and item effects hit harder. Nothing specific to Crunch's kit.

loadout.name: Tri-Core
loadout.text: Deal 5% bonus damage On-Hit, randomly Physical, Magical or True.
loadout.plain: Basic attacks deal a little extra damage of a random type. Small bonus on the punches between Crunch's abilities.

loadout.name: Memory Leak
loadout.text: Ability casts grant 5% of their Mana or Energy cost as permanent Max Mana. At 500 bonus Max Mana, gain 5% Movement Speed.
loadout.plain: Each ability cast slowly grows your max mana, and eventually gives a bit of movement speed. Helps Crunch keep casting without running dry.

loadout.name: Iceskorn Talons
loadout.text: Glacial Colosseum:  Create an Ice Sheet around you for 8s. Allies on the sheet gain 12% Physical Power for 3s. They also gain 12% Movement Speed for 3s. Enemy Units on the sheet are Slowed by 10%.
loadout.plain: Drop an ice sheet where you dive in: allies on it gain power and speed, enemies on it are slowed. Use it when your team follows you into a fight.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Demiurge (Tri-Core + Memory Leak) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 1 of the 3 players Crunch killed built physical armor (Sevarog).
No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals.

copy.text: Demiurge: 40.6% in 315 Crunch offlane games, below the hero's 48.1%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
